summary: Russia launched a massive multi-axis drone and missile strike targeting Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian oblasts on September 15, 2026, with Geran-5 missiles striking multiple Kyiv districts and Shahed drones hitting targets across central and southern Ukraine. Ukraine's Verkhovna Rada voted 317-0 to dismiss Prosecutor General Kravchenko, deepening political upheaval amid internal power struggles between the Prosecutor General's Office and NABU. A reported Ukraine-Russia energy infrastructure ceasefire brokered by Trump remains unconfirmed by either side, while Russian forces continue offensive operations in Donetsk and southern directions.
key_points: Russia struck Kyiv with multiple Geran-5 missiles hitting Solomyanka, Shulyavka, Pechersk, and Boryspil districts, with at least one shot down over Boryspil (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74674, @mon1tor_ua/74675, @mon1tor_ua/74651, @mon1tor_ua/74689).

Shahed drones launched from multiple axes struck targets across Kirovohrad, Cherkasy, Poltava, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, Zaporizhzhia, and Kherson oblasts on September 15, 2026 (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74682, @mon1tor_ua/74681).

Ukraine's Verkhovna Rada dismissed Prosecutor General Kravchenko with 317 votes; the PG Office subsequently revoked a suspicion notice against NABU Director Krivonos amid claims of NABU pressure (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33254, @ukr_leaks_eng/33262, @UkraineNow/84113).
Ukraine and Russia reportedly agreed not to strike energy infrastructure, per Trump, though neither Kyiv nor Moscow has officially confirmed the arrangement (Source: @UkraineNow/84098).

Ukraine struck Russian facilities in Taganrog, Rostov Oblast, including military airfield Taganrog-Centralny, the 325th aviation repair plant, and the Beriev aviation complex (Source: @eRadarrua/113395).

Russian Southern grouping forces are reportedly breaking through Ukrainian fortifications via ventilation channels, according to a battalion assistant commander from the 242nd Guards Motorized Rifle Regiment (Source: @tass_agency/395482).

Russia's weapons supply corridor through Poland and Romania is now at risk of disruption, warned former Polish Chief of General Staff Cieniuch, potentially hindering Western arms deliveries (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33248).
A Russian drone struck a gas station in Kyiv's Demeevka district, and a separate attack killed one person and wounded eight in Kyiv (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33266, @UkraineNow/84109).

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a large-scale multi-axis drone and missile assault on September 15, 2026, targeting Kyiv with Geran-5 ballistic missiles and deploying Shahed drones across central, southern, and eastern Ukraine. Simultaneously, Ukraine's political leadership underwent significant upheaval as the Verkhovna Rada dismissed Prosecutor General Kravchenko, triggering a power struggle between the Prosecutor General's Office and NABU. A reported energy infrastructure ceasefire brokered by Trump remains unconfirmed, while Russian forces continue offensive operations on multiple front sectors.
ukraine: Kyiv was struck by multiple Geran-5 missiles targeting Solomyanka, Shulyavka, Pechersk (Nova Zabudova), and Boryspil districts; at least one Shahed over Boryspil was intercepted. A drone also struck a gas station in the Demeevka district, and one person was killed with eight wounded in Kyiv from a separate Russian attack (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74674, @mon1tor_ua/74675, @mon1tor_ua/74651, @mon1tor_ua/74689, @ukr_leaks_eng/33266, @UkraineNow/84109).
In Vinnytsia, young men in tracksuits mobilized a civilian man in the presence of military enlistment officers, highlighting ongoing issues with mobilization practices (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33264).

Zelensky stated Ukraine is ready to ensure a corresponding absence of strikes if partners secure a genuine commitment from Russia not to strike power grids, energy facilities, critical infrastructure, or food supply routes (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33257).
Ukraine and Russia reportedly agreed not to strike energy infrastructure per Trump, though neither side has officially confirmed this arrangement (Source: @UkraineNow/84098).

Developments and testing of countermeasures against reactive Shahed drones are underway, with Zelensky stating all processes are being accelerated and financing is secured (Source: @UkraineNow/84097).
On Volyn, a Russian drone struck a passenger train locomotive, but no casualties were reported (Source: @eRadarrua/113397, @UkraineNow/84109).
In Odesa, a Russian missile attack on September 13 destroyed the EVA sorting center, which supplied stores in Mykolaiv, Odesa, and Kherson oblasts (Source: @UkraineNow/84101).
russia: Ukrainian forces struck Taganrog in Rostov Oblast, targeting military airfield Taganrog-Centralny, the 325th aviation repair plant, and the Taganrog Aviation Scientific-Technical Complex named after G.M. Beriev, where military and transport aircraft are repaired and modernized; fires broke out at the struck objects (Source: @eRadarrua/113395).

Russia's Southern grouping troops are reportedly breaking through VSU fortifications in pillboxes via ventilation channels, according to Fedya, an assistant battalion commander of the 242nd Guards Motorized Rifle Regiment (Source: @tass_agency/395482).

Russia's Valdai conference was moved from Sochi to the Moscow region due to the threat of Ukrainian drones; Putin has not visited Sochi since October 2025 and increasingly avoids cities within range of Ukrainian UAVs (Source: @eRadarrua/113398).
Lavrov stated Russia is ready for negotiations on Ukraine and has never attempted to complicate the process, saying Russia can resume talks if the other side is ready (Source: @tass_agency/395458).

Russia launched Shahed drones from multiple directions including the Black Sea, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, and Kirovohrad oblasts toward targets across central Ukraine on September 15, 2026 (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74682, @mon1tor_ua/74681).

A Russian frigate in the Baltic Sea fired two signal rockets at a Danish Air Force AS-550 Fennec helicopter conducting a planned flyby and aerial photography of the Russian ship in international waters near Gedser; Denmark condemned the incident and summoned the Russian ambassador (Source: @eRadarrua/113419).
eastern_front: Enemy forces advanced near Novyi Shakhov according to the DeepState map update (Source: @DeepStateUA/23833).
Strike UAVs operated on the west of Donetsk Oblast with a course toward Mnohove on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast (Source: @kpszsu/78336).
Strike UAVs operated on the west of Kharkiv Oblast with a course toward Poltava Oblast, while a reactive UAV operated from the west of Mykolaiv toward Odesa Oblast (Source: @kpszsu/78346).
Reactive UAVs launched from the north of Dnipropetrovsk Oblast toward Poltava Oblast in the direction of Kremenchuk (Source: @kpszsu/78344).
A UAV operated south of Kremenchuk with a southwesterly course (Source: @kpszsu/78320).
Shahed drones targeted multiple locations in Poltava Oblast including a strike toward Kremenchuk, and one Shahed struck Novoukrainka in Kirovohrad Oblast (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74682).
northern_front: A Geran-5 missile was detected flying from Chernihiv Oblast toward Kyiv Oblast, Boryspil district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74653).
Two reactive Shaheds were detected heading toward Kyiv/Vyshhorod (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74688).

Five Shaheds were detected at the border of Kirovohrad and Cherkasy oblasts with a westerly course; three Shaheds from Poltava Oblast targeted Cherkasy Oblast, Zolotonosha district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74681).
Two Shaheds from Cherkasy Oblast targeted Kyiv Oblast, Obukhov district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74681).
Two Shaheds from Kharkiv Oblast targeted Poltava Oblast, Poltava district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74681).
One Shahed from Mykolaiv Oblast targeted Kirovohrad Oblast, Kropyvnytskyi district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74681).
Kyiv was expecting a repel of the drone threat, with no further threats to the city reported after the air alert was lifted (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74678, @eRadarrua/113393).
southern_front: A reactive Shahed from Zaporizhzhia targeted Kherson Oblast (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74682).
Two reactive Shaheds from the Black Sea area targeted Mykolaiv Oblast, Mykolaiv district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74682).
One Shahed struck Oleksandria in Kirovohrad Oblast (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74682).
One Shahed struck at the border of Cherkasy and Kirovohrad oblasts with a westerly course (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74682).
One Shahed from Kirovohrad Oblast targeted Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, Kryvyi Rih district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74682).

Ukraine struck the EVA sorting center in Odesa with a Russian missile attack on September 13, destroying a facility that supplied stores across Mykolaiv, Odesa, and Kherson oblasts (Source: @UkraineNow/84101).
A reactive UAV from the west of Mykolaiv operated toward Odesa Oblast (Source: @kpszsu/78346).
air_war: Russia launched Geran-5 ballistic missiles at Kyiv hitting multiple districts: Solomyanka (Shulyavka and Vokzal areas), Pechersk (Nova Zabudova), and Boryspil; at least one Shahed over Boryspil was shot down (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74674, @mon1tor_ua/74675, @mon1tor_ua/74651, @mon1tor_ua/74689).

Multiple Shahed drones were launched across a wide front: from the Black Sea toward Mykolaiv, from Kharkiv toward Poltava, from Zaporizhzhia toward Kherson, from Cherkasy toward Kyiv and Kirovohrad, and from Poltava toward Cherkasy and Kremenchuk (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74682, @mon1tor_ua/74681).

The air alert in Kyiv was lifted at 09:57 on September 15, 2026, with the drone threat reduced to a yellow level; Kyiv was subsequently expecting a repel with no further threats reported (Source: @eRadarrua/113393, @mon1tor_ua/74678).

Drone strikes were recorded across multiple oblasts including Dnipropetrovsk, Kirovohrad, Poltava, Sumy, Kharkiv, Cherkasy, and Chernihiv, with both strike UAVs and reactive UAVs deployed (Source: @eRadarrua/113423).
Ukraine is developing and testing countermeasures against reactive Shahed drones, with Zelensky confirming financing is secured and all processes are being accelerated (Source: @UkraineNow/84097).
A drone struck a passenger train locomotive in Volyn Oblast with no casualties reported (Source: @eRadarrua/113397).
key_developments: Russia launched a mass Shahed and Geran-5 strike on Kyiv and central Ukraine on September 15, hitting Solomyanka, Shulyavka, Pechersk, and Boryspil districts; at least one Shahed was shot down over Boryspil, while Kyiv's air alert was eventually lifted (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74674, @mon1tor_ua/74675, @mon1tor_ua/74651, @mon1tor_ua/74689).

Ukraine's Verkhovna Rada dismissed Prosecutor General Kravchenko with 317 votes; the PG Office then revoked a suspicion notice against NABU Director Krivonos amid allegations of NABU intermediaries pressuring the Office (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33254, @ukr_leaks_eng/33262, @UkraineNow/84113).

Ukraine and Russia reportedly agreed not to strike energy infrastructure per Trump, though neither side has officially confirmed the arrangement, while Zelensky conditioned Ukraine's restraint on partner guarantees (Source: @UkraineNow/84098, @ukr_leaks_eng/33257).

Ukrainian forces struck Russian military facilities in Taganrog, Rostov Oblast, including airfield Taganrog-Centralny, the 325th aviation repair plant, and the Beriev aviation complex, causing fires (Source: @eRadarrua/113395).

Russia's Southern grouping is reportedly breaking through Ukrainian fortifications via ventilation channels, according to a battalion assistant commander from the 242nd Guards Motorized Rifle Regiment (Source: @tass_agency/395482).
Russia's Valdai conference was relocated from Sochi to the Moscow region due to Ukrainian drone threats; Putin has avoided Sochi since October 2025 (Source: @eRadarrua/113398).

Former Polish Chief of General Staff Cieniuch warned that the weapons supply corridor through Poland and Romania is now in Russia's crosshairs, potentially hindering Western arms deliveries as winter approaches (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33248).
sections.threat_assessment: Russia's multi-axis Shahed and Geran-5 strike on September 15 demonstrates sustained capacity to target Ukrainian cities across a wide front, with Kyiv bearing the brunt of ballistic missile attacks while Shaeds saturate central and southern oblasts. The reported energy infrastructure ceasefire, if genuine, could reduce escalation but remains unconfirmed and fragile. Russia's Southern grouping offensive operations through ventilation channels suggest continued efforts to breach Ukrainian defensive lines in the Donetsk direction. The threat to Western weapons supply corridors via Poland and Romania, as warned by former Polish military leadership, could degrade Ukraine's defensive capabilities as winter approaches.
sections.regional_response: Denmark condemned a Russian naval incident in the Baltic Sea where a Russian frigate fired signal rockets at a Danish helicopter, summoning the Russian ambassador in protest. Lavrov stated Russia is ready for negotiations but conditioned resumption on the other side's willingness. Zelensky linked Ukraine's potential restraint on strikes to concrete partner commitments regarding energy infrastructure protection. The political upheaval in Ukraine's Prosecutor General's Office, with Kravchenko's dismissal and the NABU-PG power struggle, may affect institutional capacity for wartime governance and anti-corruption enforcement.
sections.intelligence_notes: The pattern of Shahed launches from multiple axes including the Black Sea, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, and central oblasts suggests Russia maintains a distributed launch capability that complicates Ukrainian air defense prioritization. The relocation of Russia's Valdai conference from Sochi to Moscow due to Ukrainian drone reach indicates growing operational constraints on Russian leadership mobility. The internal political crisis between the Prosecutor General's Office and NABU, with allegations of intermediary pressure, may signal broader institutional instability that could affect Ukraine's governance during active hostilities. The destruction of the EVA sorting center in Odesa and the attack on the Volyn passenger train demonstrate Russia's continued targeting of civilian logistics infrastructure.
